I have started the test suite to verify the fix in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z7v7dwu5/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) and am waiting for the test run to complete.
I have resolved the proxy authentication issue in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z7v7dwu5/requests/utils.py).

### Root Cause
In [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z7v7dwu5/requests/utils.py#L960-L986), `urllib3.util.parse_url` was used to parse the URL and `parsed.netloc` was used to reconstruct the URL via `urlunparse`. Unlike `urllib.parse.urlparse`, `urllib3.util.parse_url(url).netloc` only includes `host[:port]` and omits the `auth` component. When [`HTTPAdapter.get_connection`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z7v7dwu5/requests/adapters.py#L293-L318) called `prepend_scheme_if_needed(proxy, 'http')`, any proxy authentication credentials (`user:pass@`) were stripped from the proxy URL before [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_manager_for`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z7v7dwu5/requests/adapters.py#L167-L202) and [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z7v7dwu5/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracted them, resulting in missing `Proxy-Authorization` headers and `407 Proxy Authentication Required` responses.

### Fix
Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z7v7dwu5/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) to prepend `auth` to `netloc` when `auth` is present in the parsed URL.
